notes.notes: [p]Hello, StormStrikers! This is GM Maximus.[/p][p]We’d like to share the details of the 1.50 Update (25.09.25).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Developer Comment[/h2][p]The 1.50 update makes adjustments to hero playstyles based on position, as well as their risk and crisis management abilities.[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p][b]Playstyle Adjustments by Position[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tank heroes[/b] are tuned to maintain their crowd control capabilities while sustaining prolonged engagements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Melee damage dealers[/b] have been enhanced to strengthen their infiltration abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ranged damage dealers[/b] are adjusted to exert more pressure on enemies and push the frontline.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Risk and Crisis Management Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heroes whose weaknesses were overly exposed have been supplemented with better crisis management tools in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroes that could respond too easily to crisis situations have had some of their abilities adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Future Plans[/b][/p][list][*][p]In preparation for StormStriker’s upcoming major event, we will be conducting a focused, short-term analysis of your feedback after the 1.50 update and quickly reflecting it in a minor balance update to follow soon after.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Our Thanks[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are able to prepare this major event thanks to you—our StormStriker players—who continue to believe in and support the development team, promptly report bugs, share invaluable suggestions, and warmly welcome new players.[/p][p]Even if there are areas where we still fall short, the StormStriker development team, inspired by your support, will dedicate ourselves with sincerity to bring you great joy.[/p][p]We are always deeply grateful.[/p][p]With gratitude,[b]The StormStriker Development Team[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][h2]New Character Test[/h2][list][*][p]A new character test will be conducted with partner streamers and tester players.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Crying Maid Yuna[/h2][list][*][p]Yuna is a support hero who aids her allies using the [b]Vital Sword Cheongryu[/b] and [b]Help Maid Supplies[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/a18a273c27c161ffe63c1f5251d6cc736ca7b6b9.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Character Balance[/h2][h3]Maximus[/h3][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]RMB[/b] — [b]Indomitable Shield[/b], [b]Charge of Resolve[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b] — [b]Verdict![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]R[/b] — [b]Chain of Justice[/b], [b]Roar of Conviction[/b], [b]Expel Injustice[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shift[/b] — [b]Ironblood Retribution[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ironblood Retribution[/b] damage: [b]90 → 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Verdict![/b] damage: [b]330 → 320[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ultimatum of the Hero Assembly[/b] (center hit) damage: [b]220 → 110[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]To reduce situations where Maximus could secure eliminations with [b]Verdict![/b] alone, we’re slightly lowering its standalone damage while keeping the [b]total[/b] damage of the [b]Ironblood Retribution → Verdict![/b] combo intact.Additionally, for the ultimate that combined high damage and strong crowd control, we’re shifting its focus more squarely toward [b]crowd control[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Shifu[/h3][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]RMB[/b] — [b]Indestructible[/b], [b]Thunder Dragon Slash[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b] — [b]Thunder Stamp[/b], [b]Dragon Kick[/b], [b]Dragon Stamp[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]R[/b] — [b]Dragon Kick[/b], [b]Thunder Stamp[/b], [b]Dragon Stamp[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shift[/b] — [b]Cloud Step[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Critical hit sound effect on [b]Thunder Dragon Slash[/b] moved → now triggers on [b]Dragon Kick[/b] wall collision hit[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragon Stamp[/b]: startup delay reduced[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragon Kick[/b] (kick damage): [b]150 → 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragon Kick[/b] (collision damage): [b]150 → 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragon Kick[/b] (attack detection speed): [b]0.2 → 0.25[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Extreme Dragon Fist[/b] (roundhouse stun duration): [b]1.6s → 1s[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Shifu previously possessed too much [b]safety, sustain, mobility, and damage[/b] all at once.We are keeping parts of his crowd control potential when used in a tanky role, but when played as a damage dealer, he should now be more exposed to danger.[/p][p][/p][h3]Warmonger[/h3][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]RMB[/b] — [b]Flex Harder![/b], [b]Titan Splash[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b] — [b]Totem Buster[/b], [b]Totem Fall[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]R[/b] — [b]Choke Slam[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shift[/b] — [b]Boulder Tackle[/b], [b]Titan Splash[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Totem Buster[/b] damage: [b]140 → 200[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Totem Buster[/b] range: [b]625 → 1000[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Boulder Tackle[/b] travel distance: [b]800 → 1000[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Boulder Tackle[/b] damage: [b]60 → 30[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Royal Rumble![/b] damage: [b]220 → 60[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Warmonger was showing [b]excessive mobility[/b] by chaining [b]Titan Splash[/b] and [b]Boulder Tackle[/b] together.[/p][p][b]Boulder Tackle[/b] has been adjusted to serve mainly as a [b]gap-closing movement skill[/b]—its travel distance has been increased, while its damage was reduced. When combined with [b]Choke Slam[/b], it should still enable highly effective collision plays.[/p][p][b]Totem Buster[/b] has been enhanced with higher damage and extended range, making it more reliable as a [b]finishing blow[/b].[/p][p]As for the [b]ultimate[/b], since it already includes cooldown resets and other powerful effects, we’ve reduced its damage to promote [b]longer engagements[/b] in Royal Rumble matches.[/p][p][/p][h3]Eveleen[/h3][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]RMB[/b] — [b]Antimatter Field[/b], [b]Time Dilation[/b], [b]Asteroid Cluster[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b] — [b]Hadron Wave[/b], [b]Time Dilation[/b], [b]Asteroid Cluster[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]R[/b] — [b]Tachyon Field[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shift[/b] — [b]Exotic Matter[/b], [b]Time Dilation[/b], [b]Asteroid Cluster[/b], [b]Accretion Disc[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Eveleen’s [b]Exotic Matter[/b] and [b]Accretion Disc[/b] are being restructured so that they are not meant to be used together, but rather as [b]swap skills[/b] that can be strategically chosen and utilized in alignment with a single playstyle direction.[/p][p][/p][h3]Akira[/h3][list][*][p]Skill Name Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]Dimensional Slash[/b] → [b]Demon Slash (Gwicheom)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Soul Snatch[/b] → [b]Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham)[/b] is now applied to the [b]R slot[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Skill — Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham)[/p][list][*][p]A strike that releases a demon spirit, dealing [b]50 damage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The returning slash severs the enemy’s soul, applying a [b]70% slow[/b] and dealing [b]125 damage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Demonic Sword][/b]: The demon spirit is released and retrieved more quickly.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Akira’s [b]Dimensional Slash[/b] has been renamed to align with the upcoming [b]Demonic Sword (Gwigeom) skill series[/b].The former [b]Soul Snatch[/b] skill has been repurposed and revamped into [b]Specter Slash (Gwiyoungicham)[/b].[/p][p][b]Specter Slash[/b], together with [b]Demon Slash[/b], is designed for zoning and seizing early engagement opportunities. Upon hit, it inflicts a powerful slow effect, creating an opening for Akira to chain into[/p][p][/p][h3]Alice[/h3][list][*][p][b]Wind Slash[/b] (first strike dash distance): [b]400 → 375[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Boosting Wind[/b] (dash distance): [b]725 → 625[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vortex Stinger[/b] (dash distance): [b]1275 → 1500[/b]00[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Alice’s short [b]hit-and-run movements[/b] have been tuned to [b]reduce her ability to quickly enter the frontline[/b], while [b]enhancing her capacity to break through long distances in a single move[/b], thereby strengthening her [b]frontline disengagement potential[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3] Raki[/h3][list][*][p][b]Furry Flurry[/b] cooldown: [b]8s → 4s[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Raki is being adjusted so that during combat, she can use her various skill movements to [b]dodge enemy attacks[/b] while continuously casting [b]Furry Flurry[/b], allowing her to accumulate sustained damage over[/p][p][/p][h3]Lightning[/h3][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]Lightning Excel[/b] now applied to [b]RMB slot[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiant Dance[/b] now applied to Shift slot[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Passive Adjustment — Sword Dance[/p][list][*][p]Previous: Cancels some after-delay of certain skills and chains into predetermined skills[/p][/*][*][p]New: Cancels some after-delay of [b]Limit Break[/b], [b]Spiral Stinger[/b], and [b]Radiant Dance[/b], chaining into [b]Lightning Excel[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Northern Light[/b]: after-delay reduced[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lightning Drive[/b]: after-delay increased[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spiral Stinger[/b]: after-delay increased[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiant Dance[/b]: after-delay increased[/p][/*][*][p][b]Limit Break[/b] shield amount: [b]125 → 100[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]To improve Lightning’s [b]control convenience[/b], additional key slot applications have been made.[/p][p]The usability of [b]Sword Dance (passive)[/b] has been clarified with the above changes:[/p][p]Using Sword Dance cancels allow for [b]faster movement and chaining[/b] than before.[/p][p]Not using it introduces a [b]risk of being caught by enemy attacks[/b].[/p][p]Additionally, [b]Limit Break’s entry delay[/b] can now be canceled with Sword Dance, while its [b]shield amount[/b] has been adjusted.[/p][p][/p][h3]Al-Manat[/h3][list][*][p][b]Sand Slash[/b] dash distance: [b]1400 → 1550[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Arid Blade[/b] cast speed: [b]increased[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Arid Blade[/b] after-delay: [b]reduced[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Arid Blade[/b] cooldown: [b]6s → 4s[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Al-Manat’s [b]infiltration capability[/b] via [b]Sand Slash[/b] has been enhanced.[/p][p]Additionally, adjustments to [b]Arid Blade[/b] provide more room to chain into [b]Throwing Daggers[/b], enabling smoother follow-up attacks.[/p][p][/p][h3]Rei[/h3][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]RMB[/b] — [b]Arctic Spike[/b], [b]Glacial Explosion[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b] — [b]Biting Hailstorm[/b], [b]Arctic Incantation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]R[/b] — [b]Frost Barrier[/b], [b]Arctic Winds[/b], [b]Frost Armor[/b], [b]Arctic Incantation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shift[/b] — [b]Frost Trail[/b], [b]Frost Barrier[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Frost Blade[/b] damage: [b]105 → 110[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Frost Blade[/b] fire interval: [b]0.375s → 0.4s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Arctic Spike[/b] base damage: [b]105 → 110[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Arctic Spike[/b]: piercing effect [b]added[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Arctic Spike[/b] charge time: [b]+25%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] base damage: [b]105 → 110[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] attack radius: [b]325 → 500[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] slow effect: [b]70% for 0.25s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Frost Armor[/b] duration: [b]0.75s → 1.25s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Arctic Winds[/b] cooldown: [b]10s → 8s[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Rei is being shifted toward a [b]more offensive role[/b], with a reduced emphasis on defense.[/p][p][b]Arctic Spike[/b] now has a [b]piercing effect[/b], improving her ability to counter multiple barriers and create impactful plays.[/p][p][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] has been enhanced for easier wide-area damage and team-interruption potential.[/p][p]Previously stackable defensive skills are now limited to a [b]single choice[/b], with improvements made to increase their effectiveness when used individually..[/p][p][/p][h3]Lucy[/h3][list][*][p][b]Bloody Shot[/b]: added [b]+10 center hit damage[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloody Shot[/b] explosion damage: [b]105 → 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloody Shot[/b] attack speed: [b]0.45s → 0.5s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vermilion Void[/b] damage: [b]105 → 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vermilion Void → Bloody Shot[/b] chain delay: [b]reduced[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vermilion Void[/b] can now be used while casting [b]Bloody Burst[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloody Burst[/b] center damage: [b]105 → 115[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloody Burst[/b] outer damage: [b]105 → 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bloody Burst[/b] center critical hit sound effect: [b]added[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Scarlet Execution[/b] movement speed reduction: [b]30% → 10%[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Lucy’s [b]Bloody Shot[/b] now applies additional hits, slightly boosting both [b]damage and sustain[/b] when the central projectile connects.[/p][p]By enabling smoother chaining between [b]Vermilion Void[/b], [b]Bloody Burst[/b], and [b]Bloody Shot[/b], Lucy gains stronger [b]burst damage potential[/b].[/p][p]We’ve also addressed a vulnerability where Lucy could be easily intercepted during her ultimate, providing her with [b]slightly more resilience[/b] in such situations.[/p][p][/p][h3]Teo[/h3][list][*][p][b]Pulse Mine[/b] damage: [b]200 → 150[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pulse Mine[/b] root duration: [b]0.75s → 0.5s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pulse Mine[/b] cooldown: [b]14s → 7s[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pulse Mine[/b] cast speed: [b]increased[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Pulse Mine[/b] after-delay: [b]reduced[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]Teo’s [b]Pulse Mine[/b] has been improved with two main purposes in mind:[/p][p][b]Immediate response[/b] to nearby enemies through faster deployment.[/p][p][b]Area control[/b], enabling multiple Pulse Mines to be placed as a deterrent against enemy advances.[/p][p][/p][h3]Narae[/h3][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p][b]Soul Force[/b] moved from [b]RMB → LMB[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Divine Energy[/b]: toggle functionality applied[/p][/*][*][p][b]Soul Force[/b] damage per second: [b]60 → 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Soul Force[/b] healing per second: [b]20 → 100[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes	[/h3][p]To improve [b]usability of Divine Energy[/b], a toggle function has been added:[/p][p]Clicking an ally will link [b]Divine Energy[/b] to them.[/p][p]Clicking outside the ally’s range will cancel the link.[/p][p]We are aware that some StormStrikers may find this toggle function inconvenient, and we are working to provide an [b]ON/OFF option[/b] in the near future.[/p][p]As for [b]Soul Force[/b], we discovered certain [b]system conflicts[/b], so these adjustments will be rolled back.[/p][p]Your valuable feedback will be carefully reflected in the design of future [b]swap skills[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Electra[/h3][list][*][p][b]Encroaching Thorns[/b] knockback duration: [b]0.4s → 0.2s[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]This adjustment ensures that opponents knocked back by [b]Encroaching Thorns[/b] have more time to react, granting them an opportunity to counter Electra’s [b]combo plays[/b] that revolve around [b]Fountain of Blood[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Sabio[/h3][list][*][p][b]Rescue Grenade[/b] healing per second: [b]60 → 80[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rescue Grenade[/b] self-healing per second: [b]32 → 40[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Developer’s Notes[/h3][p]We determined that Sabio’s [b]healing potential[/b] showed clear limitations regardless of player mastery.[/p][p]To address this, [b]Rescue Grenade[/b] has been adjusted to provide stronger [b]area-of-effect healing[/b], compensating for shortcomings in large-scale team fight situations.[/p][p][/p][h2]Other Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Reorganized [b]skill description effects[/b] listed at the bottom.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]maximum movement speed buff [p][/p][h1]1.49 Update[/h1][list][*][p]19 minutes ago[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"]Hello, Storm Strikers!This is GM Maximus.[/p][p align="initial"]We would like to inform you about the [b]1.49 Update (2025.08.28)[/b].[/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Before the Developer’s Comment[/h2][p align="initial"]We have carefully taken into account the streams from our streamers, the 1:1 ticket history,and the valuable opinions from our Storm Strikers in the community.[/p][p align="initial"]For this update, our goal is to expand the volume a little more,to give you inspiration to try out new challenges,and to let you feel the joy of research.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Developer’s Comment[/h2][p align="initial"]As we mentioned in the direction of the previous update,[/p][p align="initial"]we focused on [b]preserving each character’s individuality and fun, while strengthening the rhythm of combat flow and the balance between risk and return[/b].[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Maintaining strengths, adding openings[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]We enhanced the core identity of each hero, while also adjusting risks so that opponents can have opportunities to break through.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Improvement of control and connectivity[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]We refined the control feel and skill rhythm of certain heroes, and strengthened each character’s core skills and play.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Enhancement of individual combat ability[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]Since we judged that focusing on individual battles could be somewhat difficult in a team battle environment,[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]we have made some improvements to supplement individual combat ability.[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Character Balance[/h2][p]
[/p][h2]Maximus[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Verdict![/b] damage [b]300 → 330[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]When Maximus successfully suppresses an enemy,we have adjusted him so that he can finish the kill on his own,allowing him to become a more threatening presence even in individual combat.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Shifu[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Thunder Stamp[/b] cooldown [b]9s → 8s[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Thunder Stamp[/b] movement distance [b]3m → 4m[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Thunder Stamp[/b] after-cast delay decreased[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Dragon Kick[/b] cooldown [b]7s → 8s[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Dragon Kick[/b] attack range increased by [b]40%[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Dragon Kick[/b] after-cast delay decreased[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Dragon Kick[/b] jump height decreased[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]We have made some improvements to Shifu’s control feel,and by reducing the after-cast delay,we aimed for this skill to serve more effectively in combo connectionsrather than being used only as a single move.[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Eveleen[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Time Dilation[/b] movement speed increased [b]25% → 40%[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Tachyon Field[/b] shield amount [b]180 → 210[/b][/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]We aim to establish Eveleen as a hero who, based on explosive movement speed,can rapidly break through to the target point and push the frontline forward.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Additionally, we have slightly reduced the damage she takes during the breakthrough process,so that even when Eveleen accepts some degree of risk,she can still reach the target point and fulfill her role of dealing area damage.[/p][h2]
[/h2][/*][/list][h2]Volf[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]\[Charge] Flame On![/b] damage [b]105 → 110[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]We expected Volf to pressure enemies with his Charge attack,pushing the frontline and forcing opponents to use their skills.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]However, we judged that the current damage of the Charge attack was insufficient to fulfill that role in battle.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Therefore, through this adjustment,we aim to make Volf’s Charge attack more threatening,so that he can properly carry out his intended role on the battlefield.[/p][h2]
[/h2][/*][/list][h2]Bernhardt[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Death Pursuit[/b] damage increased [b]150 → 155[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Death Pursuit[/b] movement distance increased [b]525 → 575[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Rampaging Fury[/b] attack range (X-axis) [b]75 → 125[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Rampaging Fury[/b] movement distance increased [b]180 → 360[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]Bernhardt is now ready to swallow the battlefield whole.Go on a rampage to your heart’s content.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Akira[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Decimation[/b] damage [b]75 → 70[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Dimensional Slash[/b] damage [b]75 → 70[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]Compared to other melee heroes, Akira has a clear advantage in seizing opportunitiesand performing them safely.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Based on this, Akira can easily create favorable situations,and we judged that such situations were occurring too frequently,causing considerable fatigue in the flow of battle.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][/p][/*][/list][p]Therefore, while maintaining Akira’s instantaneous burst power,we have reduced the frequency with which he can seize [url="https://opportunities,in"]opportunities,in[/url] order to alleviate his excessive influence.[/p][list][*][p align="initial"][/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Alice[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Wind Slash[/b] first attack movement distance [b]3m → 4m[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]By increasing the movement distance of the first attack of Alice’s Wind Slash,we aimed to relieve some of the frustration that players felt previouslyand allow for a smoother, more comfortable play experience.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]
[/h2][h2]Al-Manat[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Sand Slash[/b] camera lock duration decreased[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Arid Blade[/b] effect changed: from Slow → to Grab[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Arid Blade[/b] cooldown [b]1.5s → 6s[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Arid Blade[/b] damage [b]75 → 50[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Arid Blade[/b] after-cast delay increased[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Path to the Underworld[/b] duration [b]7s → 8s[/b][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_249a2356a2034563b330d0330c40f8c3~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3]코멘트[/h3][list][*][p align="initial"]Despite continuous adjustment patches,we judged that the high difficulty of landing Al-Manat’s core skillsmade it difficult to fully enjoy the inherent fun of the hero.[/p][p align="initial"]Accordingly, through [i]Arid Blade[/i] we have clearly reduced the burdenboth on the judgment required to use core skills and on their actual accuracy,and instead adjusted him to focus more on the infiltration processand on seizing infiltration opportunities.[/p][p align="initial"]We hope that the assassination playstyle of Al-Manat,which until now could only be experienced by a few skilled players,can now be enjoyed by many more of you.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Rei[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]\[Charge] Arctic Spike[/b] damage [b]315 → 320[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Arctic Spike[/b] cooldown reduced [b]4s → 1s[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] cooldown reduced [b]4s → 1s[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] normal attack changed: Area attack → Single attack[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] projectile speed increased on normal attack[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Glacial Explosion[/b] charge function added[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]\[Charge] Glacial Explosion[/b] damage [b]200[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Biting Hailstorm[/b] cooldown increased [b]7s → 9s[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]When Rei secures a position,his identity as a ranged damage dealer with consistent single-target snipingand area bombardment is maintained,but we focused on ensuring that the enemy has opportunities to break through,introducing risks and openings depending on the situation.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]By removing the instant explosion effect of [i]Glacial Explosion[/i],if an enemy succeeds in closing the distance,Rei—when not choosing defensive skills—will find it harder to respond,as he must rely on accuracy.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]We also limited the long-term area control of [i]Biting Hailstorm[/i],and by introducing charge times for [i]Arctic Spike[/i] and [i]Glacial Explosion[/i],we intended to add openings in Rei’s gameplay.[/p][h2]
[/h2][/*][/list][h2]Teo[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Reload[/b] speed decreased by [b]20%[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]We judged that Teo’s mobility through [i]Tactical Maneuver[/i] was already sufficient.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]However, we also thought that the gap created during the reloading process was excessively large,making him highly vulnerable to melee dealer-type heroes who can exploit such openings with their dash skills.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Accordingly, while still leaving room for melee dealers to break through with charge abilities,we adjusted Teo so that he also has time to respond to those who have penetrated his defenses,thereby maintaining balance between the two sides.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]In addition, this adjustment is not only aimed at increasing stability,but we also hope it will allow Teo to secure competitiveness in terms of cumulative damage output,so that he can stand on equal footing with other ranged dealer heroes.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Lightning[/h2][p align="initial"]Overall aspects of the hero [b]Lightning[/b] have been improved.[/p][p align="initial"]Since the overall values have been changed,please be sure to check the detailed specifications in-game.[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Passive Skill Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"][b]\[Agility][/b] Base movement speed increased by [b]+150[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]\[Sword Dance][/b] Lightning can gracefully connect various skills,allowing some skills to be linked more quickly than others.[/p][p align="initial"][i]Example:[/i] During the casting of [i]Radiant Dance[/i],[i]Spiral Stinger[/i] can be connected faster than other skills,enabling Lightning to escape from the battlefield.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_2566c1e985bc4ab0ab7baf95e1df6ed6~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Key Slot Changes[/p][list][*][p align="initial"][b]RMB[/b] – [i]Sword Engage[/i] / [i]Lightning Drive[/i] / [i]Northern Light[/i][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]E[/b] – [i]Spiral Stinger[/i] / [i]Lightning Drive[/i] / [i]Northern Light[/i] / [i]Shooting Star[/i][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]R[/b] – [i]Shooting Star[/i] / [i]Radiant Dance[/i][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Shift[/b] – [i]Lightning Accel[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_9f55c03cb939449ebf518b1830a0f473~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Skill Effect Changes[/p][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Radiant Dance[/b]: casting delay → grants invincibility immediately upon casting[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Radiant Dance[/b]: invincibility duration decreased [b]0.8s → 0.65s[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Lightning Accel[/b]: maximum uses decreased [b]3 → 2[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Lightning Accel[/b]: added \[Dash] function in the direction of movement keys[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Shooting Star[/b]: \[Airborne] effect removed[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Skill Delay Reduction[/p][list][*][p align="initial"]The casting speed of certain skills has been increased,and their after-cast delay has been reduced.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][list][*][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_956ac22ab6a7408da5787dae863d55e2~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Comment[/b][/h3][list][*][p align="initial"]We judged that, in the previous state, Lightning’s skills and basic attacks were not clearly distinguished in terms of usage timing,making it difficult to focus on a single playstyle during combat.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Accordingly, we separated the combat rhythm into \[basic attack play] that utilizes [i]Illusion Slash[/i] and [i]Lightning Accel[/i],and \[skill-focused play] based on other skills,so that Lightning can concentrate on a playstyle that highlights his strengths within a clearer tempo.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]For the \[basic attack play] using [i]Illusion Slash[/i] and [i]Lightning Accel[/i],we reduced the cooldown of [i]Lightning Accel[/i] and increased its shield amount,granting greater strength to sustained combat centered around basic attacks.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Based on the reduced skill delays and the [i]\[Sword Dance][/i] passive,we intended for various skills to be combined and linked,so that after skill-focused play, the style can naturally flow into \[basic attack play].[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]However, we judged that the explosive damage resulting from compressed speedhas significant variability in how it is felt during actual combat situations.Therefore, in this update, we have adjusted some of the damage.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]For now, our focus is on completing the individuality and fun of the hero,and we will proceed with additional follow-up adjustments afterward.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Narae[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Soul Force[/b] damage per second [b]100 → 60[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Soul Force[/b] healing per second [b]100 → 20[/b][/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Soul Force[/b] now assigned to RMB slot[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"][b]Blessing of Grace[/b] shield amount increased [b]240 → 280[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_85dc43a4078d4b60917ff07efbe59298~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Comment[/b][/h3][list][*][p align="initial"]We wanted Narae to give more of an impression of being a teammatewho participates in battle while breathing together with allies than before.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]This change has somewhat of an experimental nature,so the control feel may be awkward, or the efficiency may be excessive or insufficient.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]However, ultimately, we want to take this as an adventure and challenge,so that in the future, with the addition of swap skills,Narae can firmly take her place as a hero who creates battles together with her team.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Chloe[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Tag! Freeze![/b] now assigned to [b]R slot[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p align="initial"][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p align="initial"]As overall kill opportunities have increased,we wanted to provide Chloe with room to adopt a survival skill.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Other Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"]The [b]Hero Introduction[/b] section will be changed from [i]Story[/i] → [i]Character Traits[/i].[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Some skill descriptions have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Hero passive skill descriptions have been moved into the basic skill description section.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Fixed an issue where [b]Warmonger – Flex Harder![/b] did not apply movement speed reduction when used.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Fixed an issue where Lightning’s [b]Limit Break[/b] did not apply the \[Unstoppable] effect upon activation.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Adjusted the effect of Lightning’s [b]Northern Light[/b] to match its attack range.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Adjusted the effect of Lightning’s [b]Shooting Star[/b] to match its attack range.[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Improved [b]Al-Manat – Hashashin[/b] so that additional attacks are triggered even when hitting a tanker’s \[Barrier].[/p][/*][*][p align="initial"]Added the missing \[Airborne] description to Electra’s [b]Encroaching Thorns[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][h1]System[/h1][list][*][p align="initial"]A function to display the list of [b]Custom Game Rooms[/b] has been added.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b4cc35_976520be04584dca9888549731cfca3c~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_506,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/b4cc35_976520be04584dca9888549731cfca3c~mv2.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h1]Profile Icons Added[/h1][list][*][p align="initial"][b]1st Queen, 2nd Queen, Streamer Lucy, Clan War[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Emotes and Sprays Added[/h2][list][*][p align="initial"][b]Chloe [/b]Smack?![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.48.2 Minor Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, StormStriker players!This is GM Maximus.[/p][p]Here’s the information for the [b]1.48.2 Update (2025.08.08)[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1]Future Balance Direction[/h1][p]While keeping each character’s [b]unique personality and fun factor[/b] as our top priority, we plan to adjust balance in the following ways:[/p][p]
[/p][h3]1. Enhance the thrill of turning the tide[/h3][list][*][p]We will strengthen each character’s core skills while making small adjustments to others to maintain overall balance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]2. Encourage strategic combat flow[/h3][list][*][p]To add more strategic depth to battles, we may increase cooldowns for certain skills.[/p][/*][*][p]In return, each skill will be given a clearer purpose.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]3. Reinforce goal-oriented play[/h3][list][*][p]We will work to clearly define everything from the team’s shared victory objectives to each character’s detailed gameplay goals.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Developer’s Comment[/h2][p]Large-scale balance changes in a short period can cause a big impact on gameplay feel.[/p][p]However, frequent changes can also create [b]adaptation fatigue[/b] for StormStriker players.[/p][p]We plan to adjust balance gradually and steadily over time.For now, this patch applies only a limited set of adjustments.[/p][p]
[/p][h1][b]Character Balance[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Bernhardt[/h2][list][*][p]Removed passive lifesteal.[/p][/*][*][p]Frenzied Dance: 30 → 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Bloodthirst instant HP recovery: 250 → 200.[/p][/*][*][p]Bloodthirst lifesteal: 25% → 40%.[/p][/*][*][p]Blitzkrieg cooldown: 6s → 7s.[/p][/*][*][p]Savage Dash cooldown: 7s → 8s.[/p][/*][*][p]Rampaging Fury damage: 105 → 100.[/p][/*][*][p]Inferno Strike damage: 195 → 225.[/p][/*][*][p]Inferno Strike cooldown: 7s → 8s.[/p][/*][*][p]Eternal Hellblade: attack speed of the initial strike increased by 50%.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed the always-on lifesteal, which gave excessive sustain without a healing-reduction system.[/p][/*][*][p]Kept the movement speed increase on Frenzied Dance hits so Bernhardt can still apply some CC and respond even without Rage stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of other skills so Rage stack management can focus on Death Pursuit and [i]Desperate Fury[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the risk of using the ultimate so it can be used in extreme situations—low HP and surrounded by multiple enemies—to attempt a comeback.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Akira[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Flashbang damage: 90 → 100.[/p][/*][*][p]Flashbang cooldown: 6s → 7s.[/p][/*][*][p]Battōjutsu damage: 195 → 225.[/p][/*][*][p]Battōjutsu cooldown: 4s → 6s.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the damage of Flashbang and Battōjutsu to boost kill potential after applying pressure with Decimation and Dimensional Slash.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased cooldowns to match the “cool-headed samurai” concept, requiring more careful use.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Raki[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Furry Flurry outer damage: 90/90/210 → 80/80/200.[/p][/*][*][p]Furry Flurry center damage: 180/180/300 → 160/160/280.[/p][/*][*][p]Kitty Rush cooldown: 2.5s → 4s.[/p][/*][*][p]Meow-ppercut cooldown: 3s → 4s.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted her ability to deal both high burst and high sustained damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Kept movement speed the same to maintain her flanking advantage.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Kitty Rush cooldown to limit the mobility advantage gained from repeatedly combining short dashes with Kitty Step in melee.[/p][/*][*][p]Kitty Step remains unchanged, as it plays a key role in compensating for Raki’s weaknesses.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Electra[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Path of Pleasure: Blood Fountain gained when healing allies: 5 → 10.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Skill description changes will be applied in the next patch.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ensures Electra remains fun and rewarding to play even when focused on ally care.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Al-Manat[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Talon of the Desert slow duration: 2s → 0.75s.[/p][/*][*][p]Spirit of the Dune duration: 10s → 8s.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Comment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Maintains her ability to set up combos with key skills like Sand Slash, Cipher Hamattan, and Hashashin.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevents excessive movement disruption that was possible with short cooldowns and long durations.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]Other Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h2][p][b]Maximu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed description errors for [i]Roar of Conviction[/i] and [i]Ironblood Retribution[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rei[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed description error for [i]Blooming Blizzard[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Chloe[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where [i]Zoom Zoom, Horo Car![/i] and [i]Boing Boing, Horo Ball![/i] could not be assigned to the Shift key.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Translation[/h2][p]Some skill descriptions do not yet have the English translations applied.We apologize for the oversight.We will make sure all of them are updated in the next patch.[/p][p]For now, please refer to the information below.[/p][h3]
Maximus[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Ironblood Retribution[/b][/p][list][*][p]Strike the ground forcefully to stun the enemies and deal damage. Gain a shield based on the number of enemies hit[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Roar of Conviction[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shout a battle cry forward to airborne the enemies and slow them while dealing damage[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Al - manat[/h3][p][b]Arid Blade[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slash the surroundings to slow enemies and deal damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Talon of the Desert[/b][/p][list][*][p]Summon the Grip of the Sands to slow enemies and deal damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Path to the Underworld[/b][/p][list][*][p]Become the Guide of the Underworld for 7 seconds, dealing additional damage on successful attacks. If you kill an enemy while in the Guide of the Underworld state, all skill cooldowns are reset.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Rei[/h3][p][b]Blooming Blizzard[/b][/p][list][*][p]Create a Frost Rose Garden to slow enemies After 2.5 seconds, the Frost Rose Garden explodes, stunning enemies and dealing damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Electra[/h3][p][b]Path of Pleasure[/b][/p][list][*][p]Swing the whip to heal allies and deal damage to enemies. Gain Blood Well when hitting allies and Blood Well when hitting enemies. Enemies can only be affected once per hit.
[/p][/*][/list]

[p][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Storm Striker players![/p][p]We would like to inform you about the upcoming [b]1.48.1 minor update[/b].

notes.title: 1.46.0 Patch Notes (May 22, 2025)
notes.notes:
Hello StormStriker players!
We’re excited to introduce the 1.46 update. Here’s what’s new:


[h2]Lightning and Teo Join the Battle[/h2]
[list]
[*] The new character Lightning makes her debut, and Teo returns to the battlefield!
[*] Please refer to the Balance section below for more details.
[/list]


[h2]Lucy's Skill Swap Added[/h2]
A new skill swap has been added for Lucy, tailored for a close-range playstyle.
Please refer to the Balance section below for more information.


[h2][/h2]Overall Balance Direction

[h3]Maximus[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developer Notes
[list]
[*] We observed that aggressive tank characters like Volf and Shifu are currently more dominant.
[*] While Maximus has a clear role, his lower-tier performance showed limited potential.
[*] To emphasize his strength as a defensive tank, we've slightly increased the shield value on his core defensive skill.
[/list]
[*] Indomitable Shield
[list]
[*] Guard Amount: 700 → 800
[/list]
[/list]


[h3]Warmonger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developer Notes
[list]
[*] Titan Splash had high mobility and a short cooldown, which often led to disjointed gameplay, with one team lacking a tank and the other missing a DPS.
[*] To address this and encourage more cooperative play, we have increased the cooldown of Titan Splash from 4s to 6s.
[*] To compensate for this nerf and strengthen Warmonger’s role as a protective counter-tank, we’ve also improved his shielding ability.
[/list]
[*] Flex Harder!
[list]
[*] Guard Amount: 700 → 800
[/list]
[*] Titan Splash
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 4s → 6s
[/list]
[*] Totem Buster
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 5s → 6s
[/list]
[*] Totem Fall
[list]
[*] Cooldown: 5s → 6s
[/list]
[*] Boulder Tackle
[list]
[*] Damage: 30 / 180 → 60 / 150
[/list]
[/list]


[h3]Eveleen[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developer Notes
[list]
[*] With other tanks receiving buffs, Eveleen’s pick rate has fallen.
[*] We're slightly buffing her LMB damage and range, and planning future updates to allow it to hit enemies along the Z-axis as well, instead of only XY.
[*] While this update includes only a small adjustment, we’ll continue to monitor her performance and raise her viability to be on par with other tanks in situational pick rates.
[/list]
[*] Quantum Cube
[list]
[*] Damage: 80 → 90
[*] Range: 7m → 8m
[/list]
[/list]


[h3]Bernhardt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developer Notes
[list]
[*] Bernhardt’s sustain fits the bruiser archetype well, but his burst DPS has been exceeding expectations, making it hard for supports to counter him effectively.
[*] To address this, we’re slightly reducing his damage output while enhancing his mobility and rage-fueled survivability.
[*] With shorter cooldowns on movement skills, we envision Bernhardt as a persistent threat that eventually overwhelms healers through sustained pressure.
[/list]
[*] Death Pursuit
[list]
[*] Damage: 10 / 140 → 10 / 125
[/list]
[*] Rampaging Fury

[*] Shield: 75 → 100

[h3]Akira[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developer Notes
[list]
[*] The swap skill Dimensional Slash has felt underwhelming compared to Decimation, particularly in terms of healing, range, and forward movement.
[*] To improve usability, we've increased its projectile speed.
[/list]
[*] Wind Blade

[h3]Lightning[/h3]
[list]
[*] Developer Notes
[list]
[*] Lightning is our third bruisertype character.
[*] She grows stronger by stacking basic attacks and was designed to be a beginner-friendly melee character that's easy to play but requires good positioning.
[*] We expect her to be a high-floor, low-ceiling character until her swap skill (Limit Break) is activated, at which point her power spikes moderately.

notes.title: Version 1.44 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Storm Striker players!
We’d like to share the details of the 1.44 update (March 27, 2025).


[h2]Overall Balance Adjustment Direction[/h2]
[list]
[*] In version 1.43, we attempted to create a more favorable environment for melee dealers by artificially removing certain crowd control (CC) effects or increasing their cooldowns.
[*] However, as we adjusted the balance in line with this approach, we found that some characters lost core skills that were key to their fun and identity, ultimately reducing their overall appeal.
[*] As a result, rather than continuing to remove CCs artificially, we’ve decided to improve the usability of movement skills for melee characters. This will allow players to use their own skill combinations more freely and naturally evade CC effects.
[*] In the 1.43 patch, we also increased the burst DPS of dealers across the board.
[*] However, this led to situations where players were defeated before they even had a chance to respond, reducing the opportunity for back-and-forth combat.
[*] To address this, we’re reverting the stats to their 1.42 patch values so players can better engage and respond during fights. (For example: when Rei and Lucy's LMB damage was at 105.)
[*] We’ll first explain the changes that were made in the 1.42 patch, followed by the final stat adjustments to be applied.
[/list]


[h3]Shifu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Intent
[list]
[*] Following the adjustments to Shifu in version 1.43, the character has re-emerged in the meta.
[*] At the moment, we see this as a positive direction and are planning to apply version 1.43 changes to version 1.42.
[*] However, Shifu’s ultimate in 1.43 had excessively high damage output, often turning a 5v5 into a sudden 4v5 and heavily shifting the flow of team fights.
[*] To address this, we plan to adjust the skill's focus from raw damage to sustained survivability.
[/list]
[*] Extreme Dragon Fist 
[list]
[*] Damage: 360 (10 hits) / 360 → 110 (10 hits) / 330
[*] Healing: 720 (10 ticks) → 960 (10 ticks)
[/list]
[*] Dragon Fist 
[list]
[*] Hitbox size adjusted: 200 / 100 / 150 → 225 / 115 / 150
[/list]
[/list]


[h3]Volf[/h3]
[list]
[*] Intent
[list]
[*] As a tank who frequently relies on shields, Volf has struggled with maintaining combat tempo due to an awkward charge mechanic.
[*] To address this, we’ve improved convenience by allowing passion gauge charging even while using a shield.
[*] Additionally, the underperforming skill Fiery Uppercut has received a new passive effect—instant full charge on hit—to give a meaningful boost to Volf's current performance.
[/list]
[*] Tenacity
[list]
[*] Passion gauge can now be charged while the skill is active.
[*] Flame On!’s charge speed is reduced to 50%.
[/list]
[*] Fiery Uppercut
[list]

[/list]
[/list]


[h3]Akira[/h3]
[list]
[*] Intent
[list]
[*] Dimensional Slash has been reverted to RMB, as it was in the 2024 version.
[*] With this change, Akira can now be played in two distinct styles: a fast-paced, dash-heavy Decimation build focused on multi-hit lifesteal, or a slower, long-range projectile-based setup.
[*] Additionally, to improve combo fluidity, Battōjutsu can now be reused after completing the LMB → LMB → RMB 3-cycle combo.
[*] Third Eye has once again been updated to grant the Unstoppable effect.
[/list]

[/list]
[/list]


[h3]Alice[/h3]

[list]
[*] Currently, Alice’s LMB attack distance is slower than the default movement speed, which often causes her to fall behind and lose track of the target after the second hit.

[*] As for Frost Armor, we determined that its long duration was excessively disrupting the timing of enemy attacks, negatively affecting the gameplay experience of melee dealers. To address this, we’ve added a stronger damage reduction to effectively block major attacks, while significantly reducing the duration.

Hello, Storm Striker Players!
We are excited to introduce the 1.43 Update (25.02.27).
This update includes balance adjustments and minor client updates.


[h2]Overall Balance Adjustment Direction[/h2]
The main focus of this balance update is to alleviate the frustration and unfairness melee dealers have been experiencing due to excessive crowd control (CC) effects. Moving forward, powerful CC abilities like stuns will be exclusive to tanks.

Melee dealers will now have ample time to shine if they make smart decisions regarding the use of tank abilities. However, as CC frequency has been significantly reduced, some melee dealers will have their sustain adjusted accordingly.

Previously, the optimal strategy was to disable melee dealers with CC before eliminating them. Now, the approach will shift towards focusing them down using the increased DPS of ranged dealers.

However, boosting ranged DPS could create a sense of unfairness for certain melee characters. To counterbalance this, some melee dealers will receive increased skill damage, allowing them to assassinate targets more easily.

notes.title: The Development Team's Thoughts on the Skill Changes
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the StormStriker Development Team.
First and foremost, we sincerely thank all of our players who have supported StormStriker for such a long time. Your passion and dedication have made StormStriker what it is today, and this has been a tremendous source of strength for us.
It has already been over a month since we began official communication with you.
During this time, we carefully reviewed the feedback you provided during the CBT. We have spent countless hours discussing, debating, and testing ideas to determine how we can create an environment where more players can join StormStriker, enjoy smooth matchmaking with similarly skilled opponents, and experience the kind of gameplay that only StormStriker can provide.
Our development team loves playing StormStriker just as much as you do, and we take pride in the game’s unique charm and enjoyment. Like you, we want to preserve what makes StormStriker special, but at the same time, we are constantly thinking about how we can attract more players to the game.
Starting today, we would like to share our thoughts and plans over several updates to explain what the development team is working on to ensure StormStriker’s success.
For our first topic, we want to address the most frequently discussed issue: the number of skill slots.


[b][h2]Background and Considerations Behind the Skill Slot Change[/h2][/b]
Our development team genuinely loves StormStriker and is dedicated to creating a game that we, as players, can also enjoy. We share the same passion for this game as our players do, and we are committed to improving it and guiding it in a better direction. In this sense, we see ourselves as both passionate fans and dedicated players.
This is why we carefully considered how changes to the number of skill slots might impact StormStriker's gameplay and overall enjoyment. We fully understand the weight of this decision and the concerns it raises.
Nevertheless, we would like to explain why we made this change, as well as how we plan to address the issues of reduced enjoyment and diminished character identity that may have arisen as a result.


[b][h2]Challenges StormStriker Faces: Limited Matchmaking Pool[/h2][/b]
We have identified two primary reasons why StormStriker has not yet reached its full potential:
[list]
[*] A lack of players, leading to unbalanced and inconsistent matchmaking.
[*] StormStriker's unique appeal is not being effectively showcased.
[/list]
Through analysis of Steam reviews, we found that over 30% of negative feedback cited issues with matchmaking. It is understandable that players would leave negative reviews if they cannot properly enjoy the game due to matchmaking difficulties.
Furthermore, a small player base often results in matches that combine players of vastly different skill levels, creating even higher barriers for new players to enjoy the game. (We are currently working on solutions to address these matchmaking issues, which we will explain in detail at a later time.)


[b][h2]Identifying the Root Cause of New Player Drop-off[/h2][/b]
The challenges faced by StormStriker cannot simply be resolved with more advertising. Even when new players join, many struggle to adapt to the game, and drop-off rates remain high, even in cases where they do not experience matchmaking issues.
To address this, we carefully analyzed the gameplay data of new players who had difficulty adapting to the game. Our focus was on identifying the fundamental reasons behind their struggles.


[b][h2]Analysis Results: Choice Overload and Difficulty in Quick Decision-Making[/h2][/b]
Our analysis revealed that while some players struggled with the fast-paced nature of the game, this was not the core issue. Many fast-paced games have achieved success, so we shifted our focus to a deeper, more critical factor.
The most significant finding was difficulty in responding effectively to combat situations in real time. Players often struggled to decide which skill to use in unexpected scenarios, leading to frustration and a lack of satisfaction in their gameplay experience.


[b][h2]Four Skills Can Be Overwhelming for Players New to the Game[/h2][/b]
According to Hick-Hyman's Law and Cognitive Load Theory, having too many choices in a high-pressure situation makes it difficult for the average person to adapt. This is why most games limit the number of options in real-time scenarios to three to four choices at most.
Even in games, binary or ternary choices (two or three options) are common, but when quick decision-making is required, having four or more options is rarely utilized. Our analysis of other successful PvP games that demand real-time decision-making revealed that most focus on three core abilities for moment-to-moment gameplay, excluding ultimate skills.
However, StormStriker offered up to five simultaneous options (four skills and an ultimate), excluding basic attacks. While this provided a challenge for highly skilled players, it became an overwhelming burden for players less familiar with the game.
As a result, many new players struggled with skill selection, making it harder for them to adapt and ultimately leading to higher drop-off rates. Based on this analysis, we concluded that reducing the number of skill slots is a critical step toward creating a more accessible environment for new players while mitigating choice overload.


[b][h2]Decision to Reduce Skill Slots to Three to Attract New Players[/h2][/b]
After much deliberation, we decided that reducing momentary options to three skills aligns better with StormStriker’s fast tempo, making it more accessible and appealing to a wider audience.
This change aims to help new players adapt more easily while allowing experienced players to continue enjoying StormStriker’s depth through strategic gameplay.


[b][h2]Enhancing the Trait System and Skill Swap System[/h2][/b]
To compensate for reducing the number of skill slots, we introduced long-term strategic options to maintain depth in the gameplay. This led to the implementation of the ‘Trait’ system.
Traits are designed to provide situational choices in each battle, enabling players to make more thoughtful decisions that align with their team’s strategic needs.
Additionally, we enhanced StormStriker’s unique Skill Swap System to allow for greater flexibility in skill configurations. Players can now adapt their skills freely during combat, moving beyond split-second decisions and focusing on overall strategy.
This system retains the fun and intensity of skill-based combat while delivering a unique and differentiated experience that is exclusive to StormStriker.
Furthermore, this change empowers players to become true masters of their chosen heroes.
Instead of switching to a different hero when things aren’t going well, players can adapt to situations by using Traits and Skill Swaps with their current hero. This enables players to deeply understand their hero, make the best use of its potential in various scenarios, and experience the joy of becoming “a player who fully masters their hero.”


[b][h2]Feedback on the First Version Presented During the CBT[/h2][/b]
During the last CBT, we introduced a version of the game with the skill slots reduced to three for the first time. Many players provided invaluable feedback on this change.
Here is a summary of the key points raised:
[list]
[*] The reduction in skill slots diminished the individuality of the characters.
[*] Characters designed around skill combos lost their intended playstyles as the reduced slots made certain combos impossible.
[*] For specific roles such as tanking or team support, players had to select certain skills, but after using them, they felt powerless with no further options available.
[/list]
Players gave detailed examples using various characters to highlight these issues.
We deeply empathize with this feedback and have been seriously considering solutions to address these concerns.


[b][h2]Feedback Analysis and Solutions[/h2][/b]
Based on player feedback, we reached the following conclusion:
[list]
[*] The original characters were designed with four skill slots in mind, which caused their unique playstyles to collapse when the number of skill slots was reduced.
[/list]
To resolve this issue, we have been considering ways to make the game more accessible to a wider audience while preserving the characters' individuality and unique playstyles.
The solution we arrived at is to redesign each character's skills.
Our goal is to ensure that even with three skill slots, each character’s playstyle remains distinct and their individuality shines through. At the same time, we aim to adapt skill combos that were originally designed for four slots to work seamlessly with three.


[b][h2]The First Example of a Complete 3-Skill Revision: Akira[/h2][/b]

[b]Akira's Redesign Goal: “3 Skills That Feel Like 4”[/b]
We are currently prioritizing adjustments for characters whose playstyles have been affected by the skill slot changes. Today, we are excited to introduce Akira as the first example of this redesign.

[previewyoutube=hCnjb5RSsGQ;full][/previewyoutube]

While Akira may not deliver the exact same feel as when the character had four skills, we have confirmed that even with only three skills, it is still possible to create an engaging and enjoyable playstyle; this serves as a promising example of how characters can retain their unique essence while being adapted to fit the new skill system. We view these changes as a thoughtful step forward, ensuring that heroes maintain their distinctiveness while aligning with the updated framework.

Starting with Akira, we plan to revisit the skill compositions and playstyles of every hero, carefully redesigning them to preserve the signature fun of StormStriker while simultaneously crafting a game that is more accessible to a broader audience. This endeavor, however, is not a simple task; the process is as demanding as redesigning the game from the ground up, and as such, we cannot adjust all heroes at once. Nonetheless, we are committed to advancing this work as quickly as possible to present you with a polished and refined final product.

During the previous CBT, it was evident that reducing the skill slots from four to three without adjusting the overall balance of the heroes led to broken playstyles or rendered certain characters incapable of fulfilling their intended roles; this outcome, while unfortunate, was entirely predictable given the lack of compensatory changes. However, in the reimagined version of StormStriker, we are actively working to ensure that each hero’s concept-driven and role-specific gameplay can be fully realized with only three skill slots.

That being said, given the time-intensive nature of this redesign process, there are still heroes for whom adjustments remain incomplete. In such cases, we will focus on fine-tuning elements such as skill balance, cooldowns, and input timing to ensure that, even with only the existing three skills, the heroes’ playstyles feel cohesive and enjoyable; this will allow players to continue having fun while we work towards completing the broader redesign.


Help Us Make StormStriker Even More Enjoyable Together
Our single goal is clear: to create a game that all players can enjoy playing.
Your feedback plays a crucial role in the process of revamping the skill system, and we deeply value your input.
To achieve this, we will actively utilize our Discord community to conduct regular tests and incorporate your suggestions as we continuously refine the game.
We have shared the reasons behind reducing the skill slots from four to three and the direction we are taking moving forward. We will continue to share our thoughts and plans with you, seeking your valuable feedback along the way.
Our commitment is to ensure that StormStriker remains a game with unique and compelling fun, while also growing its player base to become a game you can always log into and enjoy whenever you want.
Thank you.

— The StormStriker Development Team

notes.title: March 7th Update Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, Storm Striker community!
Thank you for patiently waiting for the next patch for such a long time.
The patch will take place from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM KST (Korean Standard Time) on March 7, 2024.

Thank you.



[b]Systems[/b]
- Respawn time reduced from 14 to 10.
- Increased capture speed for bases/cargo by 10%.

This is the core focus of this patch. We aim to accelerate the pace of the game by reducing respawn time and increasing capture speed.

[b]Sound[/b]
- Improved guard sound.
- Adjusted character sound balance.

We expect to increase the impact of gameplay by adjusting the balance of character sounds based on sound priority and improving guard sounds.

[b]Characters[/b]
▶Raky
- Cat Punch (RMB1) 1st hit damage: 175 → 200

Most of Rocky's first hit with Cat Punch is wasted. We've contemplated how to prevent the first hit from being wasted, and for now, we'd like to apply the same damage as the second hit.


▶Lucy
- Bloody Shot (LMB1) hit damage: 40 → 30
- Bloody Shot (LMB1) splash damage: 80 → 70
- Scarlet Banish (RMB1) damage: 50 → 100
- Scarlet Hook (RMB2) damage: 10 → 15 (Total damage: 50 → 75)
- Scarlet Hook (RMB2) cooldown: 10 → 8
- Vermilion Hand (E1) damage: 50 → 100
- Vermilion Hand (E1) cooldown: 14 → 12
- Bloody Burst (R1) damage: 200 → 250 (125/125)
- Bloody Burst (R1) removed stickiness

Lucy's initial concept is that of a skill-based dealer.
Lucy's damage with Bloody Shot at 120 was overshadowing Ray's position considerably.
Therefore, to allow her to excel using skills rather than basic attacks,
most of her other skills have been buffed while reducing the damage of basic attacks.


▶Bernhard
- Dance of Madness (LMB) Rage gained: 20 → 25
- Pursuit of Death (RMB1) 2nd hit damage: 125 → 150
- Wrathful Fury (RMB2) post-delay: 1.5 → 0.9
- Wrathful Fury (RMB2) fixed an issue with skill defense penetration
- Hell Drop (R1) upper range: 450 → 600
- Torrent of Rage (R2) cooldown: 6 → 4
- Torrent of Rage (R2) removed slow effect

The greatest fun of Bernhardt lies in the constant use of his RMB skills.
Therefore, in this patch, adjustments have been made to allow Bernhardt to gather rage more effectively,
moving in a direction where he can have greater potential.


▶Eveleen

- Time Expansion (E2) cooldown: 12 → 10

Further research is needed to understand the impact of buffing movement speed on our game.
The original cooldown of 12 seconds was too long, so we have reduced it to allow for more utility.


▶Warmonger

- Fixed an issue where the damage of Shoulder Tackle (Shift1) was not consistently applied.

This was deemed a critical bug in War Monger's combo, so we quickly addressed it.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Intro[/h1]

[i]
Hi everyone at Storm Striker! This is Alphakaman, the head of the Design team!

We're having a blast these days, busy preparing for the patch!

After the launch, we noticed quite a few areas that needed improvement. This patch is all about addressing those issues as quickly as we can, focusing on what we can implement right away!

I'll break down the details of the patch for you, item by item!

[/i]

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]

[h2]Ladder Point (LP) System[/h2]

[i]
Ladder Points will be a way for you guys to measure your skills numerically until Rank Matches are introduced! But since it's not a Rank Match yet, we've made it so it's not visible to others, so you don't need to feel too pressured about it.

[/i]

[list]
[*] You can check your LP in your profile and match result screens.
[*] If you leave the game before it starts (known as "deserting"), your LP will significantly decrease.
[*] If you leave the game after it has started (known as "dodging"), your LP will slightly decrease.
[*] The introduction of this system will result in the reset of your MMR (Match Making Rating).
[/list]

[h2]Chat System[/h2]

[i]
We know the in-game chat system has been lacking, making communication with other players challenging. This patch focuses on improving basic chats, especially with friends.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Chatting is now possible on the game result screen.
[*] Party chat in the lobby has been added.
[*] Whisper chat with friends has been added.
[*] Chatting in custom game lobbies is now available.
[/list]

[h2]Early Access Pass Expansion[/h2]

[i]
To enrich your in-game rewards before the regular season pass and store are added, we've expanded the Early Access Pass.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Early Access Pass now extends from a maximum of 15 tiers to 65 tiers.
[/list]

[h2]HUD Changes[/h2]

[i]
We've made the HUD cleaner and adjusted the camera position for more thrilling gameplay.

[/i]

[list]
[*] The design of the HUD has been changed.
[/list]

[h2]Camera Position Adjustment[/h2]

[list]
[*] The distance between the character and camera has been slightly reduced.

[h2]Game Timing Adjustments[/h2]

[i]
To provide more breathing room in the game, as battles were deemed too continuous, we've adjusted respawn and point increase times.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Respawn time increased: 12s → 14s
[*] Point increase speed in control games decreased: 1ps → 0.9ps
[*] Point increase speed in conquest games decreased: 0.5ps → 0.45ps
[/list]

[h2]Self-Healing Increase[/h2]

[i]
In Storm Striker, characters start healing themselves 3 seconds after taking damage. To facilitate smoother gameplay for characters other than healers, we've increased the self-healing rate for non-healer characters.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Narae, Chloe, Sabio's HP recovery per second increased: 75ps → 80ps
[*] All characters except Narae, Chloe, Sabio: HP recovery per second increased : 40ps → 60ps
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[i]
After identifying optimization issues post-launch, we've improved areas negatively impacting optimization, removed unused features, and lightly tuned VFX. We'll continue to focus on optimization in future patches, even if not explicitly mentioned.

[/i]

[h2]Training Ground Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added character change feature
[*] Added damage meter feature
[*] Bot characters can now be the same as the player's character
[/list]

[h2]Hitbox Height Adjustment[/h2]

[i]
We've adjusted the hitbox heights of some skills, which were too high compared to their visual representation. For Akira, we've slightly increased the size of the hitbox, which was too low even to avoid by jumping.

[/i]

[list]
[*] Volf's Righteous Strike (R) top hitbox adjusted from 400 to 300, bottom from 0 to 150
[*] Bernhard's Inferno Strike (R1) top hitbox adjusted from 600 to 300, bottom from 600 to 150

[h2]Sabio Adjustments[/h2]

[i]
Initially, Sabio was designed as a character with hit-scan attacks, leaning more towards a damage dealer. However, upon observing players' gameplay, we noticed a significant disparity between the low and high points of hit-scan. Realizing the game lacked enough healers and that leaving Sabio as a damage-focused healer was problematic, we've adjusted Sabio to be more of a hybrid between a healer and a dealer. The high points as a dealer are lowered, and the low points are raised, transferring some of the dealer capabilities to enhance the healer role.

[/i]

notes.title: Update plans after Early Access release
notes.notes:
[h1]Intro[/h1]
Hello, Storm Striker users, this is Alphakaman, the head of the Design Team.

It's already been two weeks since the release of Storm Striker.

Since the last hotfix, our development team has been fully focused on preparing the next patch.

I have revised our pre-launch plans to address the issues of Storm Striker as quickly as possible and to evolve the game into a better experience for you all. Today, I'll share those plans with you.

[h1]Update Plan[/h1]
First off, here's our major update plan up until next February. It's not long-term, but I believe it's a plan that will solve the current major issues and expand the fun that the game offers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/d6ac3a2299213fece109f61df847656d859c11b0.png[/img]

[h1]Patch#1[/h1]
This is the upcoming patch that I mentioned on Discord, originally scheduled for December 7th. However, as it includes more content than initially planned, unfortunately, the patch has been rescheduled to December 11th.

I ask for your understanding regarding this change in schedule.

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
The development team was aware that the optimization was significantly lacking, and for this patch, we applied tasks that could be quickly implemented.

The development team recognizes the importance of optimization and will continue to work on improving it.

[h2]Expanded AE PASS[/h2]
I thought now wasn't the right time to introduce monetization elements into the game, and since the addition of a season pass system is not in the immediate plans of my new update strategy, I felt that players needed some form of reward until then.

For that reason, we've dramatically expanded the Early Access Battle Pass by including items that were intended for future sale.

Below are the portraits of skins that you can additionally acquire in this expansion. (Please note that the actual color of the skins may differ from their portraits.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/9d3155e1252009b956160d881a031785ee300e09.png[/img]

[h2]Ladder Point System[/h2]
The AE Pass expansion is a system for more casual players, while the LP system is designed for the more hardcore gamers. It's not exact, but we're adding LP that somewhat reflects MMR, allowing players to quantify their skills.

However, since it's not an official ranked game, we don't want players to feel pressured, so you'll only be able to see your own LP.

We ask for your understanding as the MMR will be reset in the December 11th patch to accommodate the addition of this system.

[h2]Chat System[/h2]
We're aware that the in-game chat is currently quite limited, and it's one of the reasons the patch scheduled for the 7th has been pushed back to the 11th.

After the patch, you'll be able to chat in the lobby with your party and privately with friends through whispers.

While this isn't a complete implementation of chat, it's a significant improvement over what was available before.

[h2]Language Support[/h2]
We hope that by supporting more languages, players from a variety of cultures can enjoy the game more comfortably. In addition to English and Korean, the list of languages we plan to support are as follows:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[/list]

[h1]Patch#2[/h1]
[h2]AI Opponent[/h2]
We've noticed that many new players of Storm Striker are struggling to adapt to the game, leading to them dropping out.

Adding AI opponents is a feature intended to help these players ease into the game. Newcomers will initially play several games against AI characters, allowing them to acclimate to the game before playing with other users.

[h2]New Hero : Theo[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/636c283344bd42e2f18b96ca3492bdb264d0f862.jpg[/img]
Theo is a ranged character with simple and intuitive controls, fitting for a shooter game. We anticipate that Theo will offer a distinct and enjoyable experience compared to other ranged characters.

[h2]Skill Change Extension (Primary)[/h2]
One of the most positive and unexpected responses since the launch was to the swap skill system. Players found it more intriguing than I had anticipated, and I see great potential in it.

Naturally, it makes sense to further specialize and expand on a system that players enjoy.

Since you can't change characters mid-game in Storm Striker, we want each character to have more potential. This work, along with the trait system, should well integrate this intent into the game.

In Patch#2, as a start, we plan to overhaul underused swap skills and add a third swap skill to some characters.

For instance, Narae's E skill could change to a buff that increases allies' movement speed, and Maximus's E skill might become one that sets up a barrier upfront, making it easier to break through heavily contested corridors.

[h2]Key Binding[/h2]
This is the Key Binding feature that many of you have inquired about.
As it is indeed a necessary feature, we are aiming to add it as soon as possible.

[h1]Patch#3[/h1]
[h2]Talents System[/h2]
The Talents system is designed to allow character building during gameplay in combination with swap skills. (However, it won't be in a way that creates a disparity in progress with the opponent.)

As I mentioned earlier in the **Skill Change Extension (Primary)**, it's an additional system intended to deepen the aspects of the game that players find interesting.

I will organize and share more detailed information about this system sometime next week.

[h2]New Hero : Electra[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/153bbcc4fbbc7750ae9b7d842a1ad2b27cfa9781.jpg[/img]
Electra is a healer with an explosive combination of healing and damage potential, featuring a resource system reminiscent of Bernhard's rage.

Initially designed to be a sub-healer similar to a damage dealer like Sabio, Electra has been modified to also serve as a main healer like Narae, depending on the swap skills used. This flexibility will be reflected in the upcoming release.

[h2]Shop & BattlePass[/h2]
BM (Business Model) is essential for the survival of the development company and also a way for us to provide various content to our players. There's not much to elaborate on this. We're eager to offer a wider range of skins to our users soon.

[h1]Patch#4[/h1]
[h2]Skill Change Extension (Secondary)[/h2]
Following the Skill Change Extension (Primary), the Skill Change Extension (Secondary) will involve a re-evaluation of swap skills, and we plan to add a third swap skill to all characters. This patch, along with these adjustments, is likely to also address the many changes brought about by the Talents System.

[h2]New Hero : Shifu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44394725/0fdd7dfda6da8a6023c4d4d120b72437955e49b4.jpg[/img]
Siphu is a fast and versatile melee healer who can deal damage to enemies while also healing nearby allies.

Depending on the swap skills chosen, Siphu can be specialized either to dominate enemies alongside tanks or bruisers, or to protect allied ranged characters from the backline.

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Like the Key Binding feature, there have been many inquiries about pad support. We hope that this change will allow more people to enjoy the game more comfortably.

[h1]Outro[/h1]
By the next patch on the 11th, the development team plans to cover the Talents System and detailed contents of the patch on the 11th, as well as hold an AMA session.

We ask for your continued interest and support. The development team will do our best to provide you with a better game.

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice for the November 23rd Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, this is GM KM from Storm Striker.

I would like to provide an advance notice regarding the scheduled update for November 23rd.

The update on November 23rd will prioritize adjustments to the Assassin and Tank characters.

- All Characters
  * Our first priority is to distribute damage output more evenly.
  * There will be enhancements for Tank and Bruiser types, along with downward adjustments for Assassins and Ranged characters.

- Assassins:
  * Currently, it's possible for Assassins to defeat opposing characters in a single combo; our goal is to add additional steps to this process.
  * We aim to reduce burst damage while maintaining overall DPS.
  * We want to mitigate conditions that allow Assassin characters to eliminate enemy players without risk. However, we'll ensure that the value of Assassins does not become too diminished during this process.

- Tanks:
  * The development team acknowledges that there are often situations where Tank characters do not have a significant impact on the game.
  * For Maximus and Warmonger, we plan adjustments such as increasing movement speed so they can more effectively influence team play.

We will provide detailed information through an additional announcement later on. 

Thank you.
